hero.eyebrow: Give the AI you already use a memory
hero.subtitle: Connect the AI tools you already use to verilix. Your conversations get distilled into structured notes that build up — and only what's relevant flows into the next one.
hero.freeNote: No card required. Start in a minute.

loop.heading: A loop that deepens as you use it
loop.subheading: No conversation ends when it ends. What you talk through becomes the ground for the next one, again and again.

steps.title: Talk to your connected AI
steps.description: Ask and think out loud in the tool you already use. Organizing it is verilix's job.

steps.title: Distilled into a note
steps.description: Once a topic matures, it is saved as a structured note — title, summary, conclusion, learnings, action items.

steps.title: Builds your knowledge base
steps.description: Notes don't scatter. They're grouped by category and tag into a knowledge base that's yours.

steps.title: Fed into the next talk
steps.description: Bring the topic up again later and only the notes that matter right now are quietly carried into the conversation.

distill.heading: One conversation, one clean note
distill.subheading: No summarizing on your side. verilix pulls the essentials out of the talk and gives them structure.

transcript.text: Based on the three options we narrowed down last time, help me set the direction for this project.
I looked back at the three. Given where things stand, the second fits best — on both risk and timeline…
Good. So what needs to happen by next week?
Flesh the plan out into a doc, share it with the team, and fold in their feedback — in that order.

fields.heading: Summary
fields.body: Narrowed from three options to the second direction

fields.heading: Key conclusion
fields.body: Second direction chosen, weighing risk and timeline

fields.heading: Learnings
fields.body: Setting criteria first beats narrowing options first when deciding direction

fields.heading: Action items
fields.body: Flesh out the plan → share with the team → fold in feedback

connect.heading: Connected in a minute
connect.subheading: Paste the address below into your AI tool's connector settings and sign in with your verilix account. From then on, that conversation can search and save to your knowledge base.
connect.serverHint: Paste this into the connector setup screen.

methods.title: OAuth login
methods.description: Just enter the address — a login screen appears, and connecting your account is all it takes. No key to copy.

methods.title: API key
methods.description: For tools where you enter values in a config file, pass an issued key as a Bearer token alongside the address.

calls.detail: Found 3 related notes in the knowledge base
Saved this conversation as a new note
Swept the full library and tidied tags and folders

library.heading: Keep what you've built
library.subheading: We thought about a library you'd want to open every day before we thought about a feature list.

items.title: Auto-structured
items.description: Pulls title, summary, conclusion, learnings and action items out of the conversation.

items.title: Nothing is lost
items.description: Every edit is kept as a version, and deleted notes stay in the trash for you to restore.

items.title: Stays organized
items.description: Folders, categories and tags keep a growing pile of notes easy to scan.

items.title: Search by meaning
items.description: Finds notes that are close in meaning, even when the words don't line up exactly.

items.title: Weekly digest
items.description: An email each week on what piled up and how your interests shifted.

items.title: Same knowledge everywhere
items.description: Use it on this screen, or from the other AI tools you already use — one knowledge base.

cta.heading: Your first conversation becomes your first record
cta.subheading: Connect now, and a line from today's conversation is still there for you later.
cta.note: There's no charge for the MCP connection.

footer.tagline: Your own AI knowledge partner, growing deeper with every conversation
